analysis.title: Standard Nuclear Inc. (STDN): First Take: Solid 3Q26 results as backlog improves
key_insights: STDN 3Q26 revenue was $6.0mn, above GSe $5.7mn and FactSet consensus $5.5mn.
3Q26 EBITDA was ($14.8mn) versus GSe ($3.2mn). Adj. EBITDA, which excludes share-based compensation, was ($4.5mn).
3Q26 net income was ($13.1mn) versus GSe ($19.6mn). Interest income of $2.0mn beat GSe $1.7mn.
Total Contract Backlog rose to $577.2mn at end of 3Q26 from $241.5mn at end of 2Q26, more than doubling. Funded Backlog rose to $119.6mn from $61.9mn.
Qualified Pipeline fell to $844.7mn from $986.3mn in 2Q26. It recovered from about $696mn in late August as new opportunities replaced those converted into executed contracts.
GS keeps a Buy and a 12-month price target of $18, 44.2% above the $12.48 price as of 11 Nov 2026. The target is a 50/50 blend of a ~$19/sh DCF and an $18/sh EV/EBITDA valuation.
Key risks are dependence on early-stage customers, uncertain timing of regulatory licensing approvals, competition and feedstock availability.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 revenue beat and backlog more than doubled to $577.2mn. The price target is unchanged at $18, set on 10-Aug-26 when the stock closed at $11.45.
